paraphrase: Inscriptions of the Kōḍiya-maṭha at Balligāve praise its Kālāmukha ascetics as masters of the Lakula doctrine, of Pātañjala yoga, Nyāya, Vaiśeṣika, Mīmāṃsā, Sāṃkhya and Buddhist doctrine, grammar and poetry, and record the maṭha as a place of feeding, teaching and care of the sick, belonging to the Śakti-pariṣad.
notes: A composite summary of a group of inscriptions, from memory; individual records not checked.
